*932Certiorari, 348 U. S. 808, to the St. Louis Court of Appeals of Missouri. Argued January 31, 1955. Decided February 7, 1955.

Per Curiam:

The writ of certiorari is dismissed as improvidently granted.

Milton Yawitz argued the cause for respondent. With him on the brief was Chas. D. Long.
